seed_scope: Five independent continuation RNGs and new-module initializations,conditional on the same frozen pretrained V2 parent/providers/replay;not five independently pretrained lineages.
objective: Only original native full-horizon variational actor-critic EIG,discount1,use_PCE=False;no balancing,diversity or cost reward.
initialization: Same frozen V2 runtime16001 per run;pair-specific new encoder/router seed;zero output layers;one fresh Adam at inherited terminal LR;online target copy;same native critic/posterior/replay.

diagnosis_bank.purpose: Fresh diagnostic simulations for stage-average routing and feature summaries,not model/checkpoint selection;primary EIG always canonical bank.

comparison.seed_inference: Paired t intervals/tests across five seed EIG means;Holm correction for two primary hypotheses;case CIs separately conditional on contrast bank.
comparison.attribution: Five-seed 2x2 trained factorial:full,router_only,encoders_only,V2-control. Secondary interaction full-router_only-encoders_only+V2-control. Frozen-checkpoint interventions are functional attribution only.
comparison.control: V2 control is functionally V2 in the same wrapper with zero frozen new branches;validate action and gradient equivalence;extra2000 continuation updates,not rerunning original V2 training.
comparison.test_bank: Previously observed reference benchmark,not an untouched test. Terminal2000 only,no model selection or adaptive extension from test EIG.
comparison.completion: All seeds and arms required for campaign-complete claim;incomplete runs preserved and never silently replaced;no automatic retries.

resources: Sequential LabPC GPU runs;locks and active-process checks;CPU/process and GPU utilization samples,peak memory,offline/online/scorer timing and simulator/model-derived calls. Costs are measurements,not rewards.
